name: Humanoid robotics
prompt: Examine actuator, sensing, control-software and manufacturing bottlenecks in humanoid robotics. Request disclosed commercial shipments, customer concentration and production costs. Separate prototypes from recognized revenue and independently verify every company association.

name: AI computing infrastructure
prompt: Investigate AI accelerator demand, memory, networking, packaging and data-center power constraints. Begin with NVIDIA as a company research example, verify its segment disclosures, and distinguish that company evidence from conclusions about the whole industry.

name: High-bandwidth memory
prompt: Research high-bandwidth memory capacity, qualification cycles and customer concentration. Seek dated supplier disclosures and consistent capacity units. Treat unsourced utilization rates, pricing and supply forecasts as unavailable.

name: Optical interconnects
prompt: Compare pluggable optical modules and co-packaged optics using dated technical and supplier disclosures. Separate announced products, qualification and commercial shipments. Document power, bandwidth and reliability measurements with units.

name: Advanced circuit boards
prompt: Investigate multilayer circuit boards and materials for data-center equipment. Seek supplier revenue disclosures, capacity, yield and customer concentration; keep materials and finished-board economics separate.

name: Global semiconductor supply chains
prompt: Map semiconductor design, equipment, fabrication and packaging dependencies from primary disclosures. Analyze inventory and capital intensity without assuming domestic substitution. A NVIDIA run is one company case, not a measurement of the entire supply chain.

name: Solid-state batteries
prompt: Compare battery chemistry and manufacturing approaches using dated test conditions. Separate laboratory cycle life, pilot output and commercial revenue; verify sample size, temperature and energy-density units before comparisons.

name: eVTOL and advanced aviation
prompt: Investigate advanced aircraft certification, manufacturing funding and operating infrastructure in the United States. Use FAA and company filings; distinguish conditional orders, certified operations and recognized revenue.

name: Autonomous driving
prompt: Examine autonomous-driving sensors, compute, software and vehicle integration. Require operating-domain definitions and dated regulatory evidence. Separate test miles, paid operations and safety claims; avoid comparing incompatible exposure measures.

name: Drug development
prompt: Research a drug-development value chain using FDA records, trial registries and filings. Separate trial endpoints, approval status, patent exposure and commercial sales. Record missing trial evidence and avoid extrapolating clinical outcomes.

name: Grid infrastructure
prompt: Investigate transmission, distribution and grid equipment investment using utility filings and government records. Separate approved spending, backlog and recognized revenue, and document permitting and lead-time uncertainties.

name: Aerospace and defense
prompt: Analyze aerospace and defense suppliers using public procurement records and filings. Distinguish appropriations, awarded contracts, backlog and recognized revenue. Examine program concentration and contract accounting risks.

name: Fusion energy
prompt: Review fusion-energy development using primary experimental and regulatory sources. Separate experimental gain definitions, engineering milestones and commercial generation; treat commercialization timelines as uncertain unless explicitly sourced.

name: Commercial space
prompt: Research launch, satellite manufacturing and satellite connectivity using regulatory records and company disclosures. Distinguish announced constellations, deployed capacity and paying customers; record launch and financing risks.

name: AI-enabled biotechnology
prompt: Investigate AI-supported drug discovery using trial registries, publications and filings. Separate computational results, validated candidates, clinical progress and licensing payments. Require evidence for claimed improvements in cost or development time.

name: Critical minerals
prompt: Research critical-mineral supply chains using geological surveys and producer disclosures. Separate reserves, resources, extraction and refining capacity. Specify commodity grade, currency and observation date; Canada remains planned for company fundamentals.

name: AI software applications
prompt: Investigate enterprise AI applications using Microsoft as one initial company case. Verify disclosed monetization, infrastructure spending and customer usage; distinguish product announcements from measured revenue and keep industry-wide adoption unavailable without a source.

name: Consumer AI hardware
prompt: Examine consumer AI devices, component costs and software dependencies using Apple as one initial company case. Verify filings before linking product categories to revenue and distinguish marketing claims from measured adoption.

name: Energy storage
prompt: Research stationary energy storage with deployment records, utility disclosures and supplier filings. Keep power and energy units distinct, document duration and chemistry, and separate installed systems from announced pipelines.

name: Data infrastructure and governance
prompt: Investigate data infrastructure, access rights and governance using primary technical, legal and company documents. Microsoft is a possible company example only after verification. Distinguish compliance statements, contractual rights and measured commercial outcomes.
